description: This file defines a utility class 'NotesColorUtil' for handling color contrast calculations, including caching contrast ratio checks and comparing color pairs for a note-taking Android application.

classes.name: NotesColorUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to evaluate color contrast sufficiency for UI elements, with internal caching for performance.

classes.name: ColorPair
classes.description: A private static inner class representing a pair of colors used as keys in the contrast cache.

methods.name: contrastRatioIsSufficient
methods.description: Checks if the contrast ratio between two colors exceeds 3, using cache for efficiency.

methods.name: contrastRatioIsSufficientBigAreas
methods.description: Checks if the contrast ratio between two colors exceeds 1.47, suitable for larger UI areas, with caching.
